questions.q: A big client invited me to a conference in Berlin, but I said I was too busy. What a ___!
questions.explainRo: **Missed opportunity** = ocazie ratată, o șansă pe care n-ai folosit-o.

questions.q: If our app ___ a dark mode, more people would use it at night.
questions.explainRo: Condiționalul 2 (situație imaginară în prezent): **if + past simple**, apoi would + verb; „would” nu intră în propoziția cu if.

questions.q: Our kitchen renovation ___: in the end it cost almost twice as much as we had planned.
questions.explainRo: **Go over budget** = a costa mai mult decât bugetul planificat.

questions.q: We only have two days in Rome, so let's make the ___ of them.
questions.explainRo: **Make the most of** = a profita la maximum de ceva.

questions.q: I wish I ___ dance – I always feel so awkward at weddings.
questions.explainRo: Despre o abilitate pe care nu o ai spui **I wish I could**; „wish + would” nu se folosește despre tine însuți.

questions.audio: If I were the boss, I'd cancel Friday meetings.
answers: If I were the boss, I'd cancel Friday meetings.
If I were the boss, I would cancel Friday meetings.
questions.ro: Dacă eu aș fi șeful, aș anula ședințele de vineri.
questions.explainRo: Condiționalul 2: **if I were**, apoi **would + verb** (I'd = I would).

questions.q: I wish I ___ (not / eat) that second pizza last night – I feel terrible.
questions.explainRo: Regretul despre trecut se exprimă cu **wish + past perfect**: I wish I hadn't eaten.

questions.ro: Măcar dacă ar fi ascultat de instinctul ei!
questions.explainRo: **If only + past perfect** exprimă un regret puternic despre ceva din trecut.

questions.ro: Aș vrea ca clientul să se hotărască odată.
questions.explainRo: **Wish + would** arată iritare față de comportamentul altcuiva și dorința ca el să se schimbe.

questions.q: If our CTO weren't so stubborn, we ___ to a better framework last year.
questions.explainRo: Condițional mixt: o trăsătură permanentă (prezent) explică ceva din trecut („last year”), deci **would have + V3**.

questions.q: If we had hired a second developer in spring, we ___ (not / be) so stressed now.
questions.explainRo: Condițional mixt: o decizie din trecut are urmări **acum**, deci **if + past perfect**, apoi **would + verb**.

questions.ro: Dacă am fi plecat mai devreme, n-am fi pierdut trenul.
answers: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
If we had left earlier, we would not have missed the train.
If we'd left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
If we'd left earlier, we would not have missed the train.
We wouldn't have missed the train if we had left earlier.
We would not have missed the train if we had left earlier.
We wouldn't have missed the train if we'd left earlier.
If we had left sooner, we wouldn't have missed the train.
If we'd left sooner, we wouldn't have missed the train.
We wouldn't have missed the train if we had left sooner.
questions.explainRo: Condiționalul 3 (trecut imaginar): **if + past perfect**, apoi **would have + V3**.
